title: Selected Topics in Architecture; Weaving Objects, Weaving Buildings, Weaving Drawings
description: This course aims to bring a team of students together to study the deep histories of weaving in human culture through precedent research, and to investigate the underlying orders of woven objects (hats, baskets) and structures (courtyard houses, stadiums and arenas, religious spaces, huts, nests) through the creation of two-dimensional drawings/diagrams.
